r11b-001.gate_key: present_continuous | B1.2 | gap | We need a new printer: ours ___ always ___ in the middle of big jobs. |

item.q: We need a new printer: ours ___ always ___ in the middle of big jobs.
item.why: *always* goes between *am / is / are* and the verb-ing: *They're always arguing*, not *always are arguing*.
item.why_lv: *always* liek starp *am / is / are* un darbības vārdu ar *-ing*: *They're always arguing*, nevis *always are arguing*.

r11b-002.gate_key: present_continuous | B1.2 | gap | My old car ___ constantly ___ down, so in the end I sold it. |

item.q: My old car ___ constantly ___ down, so in the end I sold it.
item.why: *so in the end I sold it* is the past, so *was* + *constantly* + verb-ing: *was constantly breaking down*.
item.why_lv: *so in the end I sold it* ir pagātne, tāpēc *was + constantly* + darbības vārds ar *-ing*: *was constantly breaking down*.
